frontmatter.title: LLMs Are Not Products: Why AI Applications Matter More Than Models
frontmatter.subheading: Understanding the real difference between large language models and production-grade AI applications
frontmatter.excerpt: Large language models get the spotlight, but AI applications deliver real value. Learn why LLMs alone are not products, how AI workflows turn models into systems, and what AI engineers should focus on when building scalable, reliable AI applications.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
